summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The WisdomTree Dynamic International Equity Fund (DDWM) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in total market equity. The fund tracks a dividend-weighted index of dividend-paying developed-market equities outside the US and Canada. The index dynamically hedges currency exposure for USD investors based on three equal-weighted signals. DDWM was launched on Jan 7, 2016 and is issued by WisdomTree.

holdings.infoBox: DDWM is an equity ETF with a total of 1489 individual holdings. The top holdings are U.S. Dollar stock at 19.33%, HSBC Holdings at 1.78%, Intesa Sanpaolo at 1.28%, Shell at 1.21%, and Novartis AG at 1.12%.
